cohort: The study included 27 term infants under 7 days old with sepsis, receiving IV antibiotics for >3 days, and resolving mild unconjugated hyperbilirubinemia.
finding: Ceftriaxone is not associated with a bilirubin-displacing effect in infants with a mild unconjugated hyperbilirubinemia.
followup_time: Up to 6 days postnatal (measurements taken on postnatal days 4-6; specific effect measured 15 minutes after ceftriaxone administration)
